description: Mo hinh Kripke DAC TA THIET KE (spec) cho vong doi don hang cua module Orders trong VFitAI. Cac gia tri trang thai (Dang xu ly / Dang giao / Da giao / Da huy) va rang buoc chuyen trang thai duoc suy ra tu logic dung o endpoint PUT /api/orders/:id/cancel (index.js dong 873-911), noi CHI cho phep huy don khi status hien tai la 'Dang xu ly'. Day la mo hinh THEO Y DINH THIET KE (nhu he thong LE RA phai hoat dong), dung de doi chieu voi mo hinh ACTUAL phan anh code that o PUT /api/orders/:id (khong co rang buoc).

properties_to_check.description: Khong bao gio ton tai trang thai 'da giao nhung bi doi nguoc lai' - mot don hang da giao thanh cong khong the bi sua trang thai ve truoc do.
Khong bao gio ton tai trang thai 'da huy nhung van duoc giao' - mot don hang da huy (va coupon/hang da duoc hoan) khong duoc phep tiep tuc giao.
Ton tai it nhat mot duong di hop le tu trang thai khoi tao den 'Da giao' (tinh kha thi cua he thong - khong bi thiet ke qua chat den muc khong the giao hang duoc).
